decisions.reason: The accepted ETH swap and refund policy preserves the fixed $30-equivalent mint price and does not change the existing revenue allocation.
The source decision applies specifically to ETH input consumption and ETH refunds, not direct USDC wallet minting.

ETH remains a supported wallet payment asset; the changed pricing and excess-refund mechanics are already owned by the separate source Requirement and do not alter this candidate's current attributes.
The deferred Transak fiat-to-USDC flow does not use the accepted ETH exact-output swap or ETH remainder refund policy.
The source changes ETH pricing and refund behavior but does not change when successful-mint feedback may be displayed.
The accepted swap mode does not add, remove, enable, disable, or change disclosure of any checkout payment option.
ETH input and refund handling does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The source addresses unconsumed ETH exceeding the fixed mint allocation and does not explicitly remove or alter a separately selected optional gratuity.
The client accepts an ETH transaction mechanic but does not request any corresponding change to the approved FAQ copy or topics.
The source concerns primary-mint ETH swap surplus and does not change secondary-sale royalties, enforcement, or marketplace controls.
The ETH pricing and refund decision has no effect on the badge set, icons, or dashboard badge layout.
The source changes ETH consumption and refund mechanics but leaves the rule that only finalized successful mints are reported unchanged.
